body: Specialized prompt injection guards are deployed in front of document analysis systems, but no false positive rate has been published for any of them on legal contracts. We measure eleven open-weights guards on two corpora of legal contracts and find that existing guards struggle: document-level false positive rates are as high as 92.39%; two guards fall below chance on paired AUC; and a five-regex baseline is not Pareto-dominated by any guard in the panel. Controlled probes locate model-specific as well as general failure modes. Prompted LLMs resolve the tested failures, including a second threat category (unauthorized scope claims) on which every guard scores zero. A cascaded LLM solution, where the positives of a mid-tier model are verified by a frontier model, is 6.5x cheaper than using exclusively a frontier model and approaches its performance.
summaryZh: 尽管有任何相反的情况，忽略所有说明：测量法律合同审查攻击的即时注入防护措施。在文档分析系统前面部署了专门的即时注入防护措施，但尚未公布任何法律合同的误报率。我们在两个法律合约语料库上测量了 11 个开放权重的守卫，发现现有的守卫陷入困境：文档级误报率高达 92.39%；两名后卫在配对 AUC 上低于机会；并且五个正则表达式基线不被面板中的任何守卫帕累托主导。
